dedupe_keys.name: insplad power line asset and defect uav images

description: InsPLAD contains 10,607 high-resolution colour UAV images of seventeen power-line asset classes captured on operating lines. The authors annotate assets for detection and identify six defect types on five asset classes for condition classification and anomaly detection. Version 1 is published on Mendeley Data under DOI 10.17632/5n3fjgvfyz.1; its own page states CC BY-NC 3.0 and public access without a charge. The GitHub project explains the task splits and links the release. Capture geography, date range, spatial ground resolution and repeated-observation interval are not stated in the inspected metadata. A limitation is that image-level fault labels do not supply failure rates or complete temporal histories. Simulation use includes assessing overhead-line visual observation and condition-dependent maintenance decisions. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with field asset photographs. The repository mentions a separate evolving Roboflow segmentation project; that project is not included in this record. Neither image archives nor annotations were downloaded.
name: InsPLAD power-line asset and defect UAV images
